reason: Entry: "Added `completions` capability to explicitly indicate support" - an explicit capability declaration (negotiation rigor), not a new primitive -> DP5 (plane in row 2).
Entry: capability "to explicitly indicate support for argument autocompletion" = a party advertising what it offers -> P3.
Entry: "Clarify security considerations and best practices in the authorization spec" - tightens the OAuth-based authorization spec -> DP2; entry names no non-OAuth hardening.
Entry: "Add `_meta` field to additional interface types, and specify proper usage" - schema fields on existing primitives -> P4, not a versioning/extension policy.
Entry: "`title` field for human-friendly display names" is a UI-facing richer primitive -> OTHER; "name as programmatic identifier" is only a side effect.
Entry: "Update `ElicitResult` and `EnumSchema`... support titled, untitled, single-select, and multi-select enums" reshapes how the user is asked for input -> DP4.
Entry: "servers must respond with HTTP 403 Forbidden for invalid Origin headers" - Origin validation is security hardening outside OAuth -> OTHER.
Entry leads with "Move experimental tasks out of the core protocol and into an official extension" -> DP5 (moves features to extensions).
Entry: "replaces the blocking `tasks/result` method with polling via `tasks/get` and a new `tasks/update`" changes how task work is tracked -> P2.
Entry: deterministic order "to enable client-side caching and improve LLM prompt cache hit rates" -> DP1 (supports caching).
Entry: "Define an error code allocation policy partitioning the JSON-RPC server-error range" - reserved ranges for spec vs implementations -> P6.
Entry: "Deprecate the Roots, Sampling, and Logging features... remain fully functional" - only lifecycle status changes -> P6 (deprecation policy).
Entry: "Reclassify the HTTP+SSE transport... as Deprecated under the feature lifecycle policy" - wire format unchanged, only lifecycle state -> P6.
Entry: "Reclassify the `includeContext` values... as Deprecated" - lifecycle status change only, kept consistent with rows 12-13 -> P6.
Entry: "`schema.json` now correctly reflects... `number`'s and not just `integers`" - a fix to the wire schema's numeric encoding -> P1; no primitive is named.
Entry: "Add optional referenceTaskIds for task followups" - links a message to earlier tasks; no long-running/async aspect stated -> OTHER.
Entry: referenceTaskIds relates a new message to earlier tasks (task/message primitives) -> P4, not state tracking.
Entry: "Add mTLS to SecuritySchemes, add oauth2 metadata url field, allow Skills to specify Security" - mTLS and per-skill security are not OAuth -> OTHER.
Entry: "Add `signatures` to the `AgentCard`" - signed metadata, which the codebook lists under P5.
Entry: "Elevate a2a.proto... to the universal, normative source of truth" - makes the proto/IDL wire definition canonical across bindings -> P1.
Entry: error responses for "HTTP+JSON and JSON-RPC bindings" change format (application/problem+json -> application/json) -> P1.
Entry: "tenant field added to all request messages... serve multiple agents from a single endpoint" is request routing on the wire, not session state -> P1.
Entry: "NEW: Canonicalization (RFC 8785) clarified for Agent Card signature" - pins down normative signing/verification rules -> DP5.
Entry: Agent Card "signature verification using JWS and JSON Canonicalization" - signed metadata/trust -> P5 (consistent with row 19).
Entry: "List Tasks implementation must switch from page-based to cursor-based" - request/response semantics of a list operation -> P4.
Entry: "NEW: New operation ListTasks with filtering capabilities" - new operation on the Task primitive -> P4 (same reading as row 25).
Entry: "Multiple concurrent subscriptions supported per task" concerns observing long-running tasks -> DP3; no scale-out reason is stated.
Entry: "NEW: index field indicates artifact position in task's artifacts array" - a detail of the artifact primitive, no long-running aspect -> OTHER.
Entry: the index field describes the artifact in "the task's artifacts array"; artifacts are an A2A primitive -> P4 (consistent with row 28).
Entry: operations "RENAMED", model "flattened" - naming/schema tidy-up -> DP5; "authentication enhanced" is minor next to it.
Entry: push-config operations renamed and the model flattened - operation/primitive semantics -> P4 (same reading as rows 25-26).
